'''Surprise Squadron''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] composed of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]].<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> it participated in the [[Taking of Kuat]] by using ion torpedoes to disable four enemy starships in helping to capture [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="Warfare" />
